varying_noncausal_fields.interpretation: bounded process-policy replay only; not a causal performance comparison or denominator

progress_markers: first passing run_check per check_id and worktree_diff_hash
progress_contract.false_stop_rule: any later public progress marker after the candidate trigger
progress_contract.false_stop_false_interpretation: no later progress observed in this trace; not a future safety proof
progress_contract.observed_suffix_interpretation: observed post-trigger resource suffix; not causal savings

rejection_fingerprint.correlation_use: join validation only; correlation ID is not emitted or hashed

decision.repeated_rejection_result: not-admitted: every tested threshold that intercepted D-089 also false-stopped later public progress
decision.relative_context_result: not-admitted: every tested candidate had a false stop or lacked cross-task generality and leave-one-task-out stability
decision.absolute_context_result: sensitivity-only: 90000 characters safely intercepted only the observed D-089 AnyIO run and is post-hoc single-task evidence

next_gate.budget_terminal_rule: a terminal trace-qualified budget stop remains an agent_failure row and is never dropped, rerun, or replaced
